# Acme Analytics

Acme Analytics helps mid-market e-commerce teams track revenue attribution across every marketing channel. Plans start at $199/month with a 14-day free trial. Trusted by over 500 online retailers.

## Why Acme
- Real-time dashboards, no engineering setup required
- Dedicated onboarding specialist for every account
- SOC 2 Type II certified

# Pricing

- Starter: $199/month, up to 10,000 tracked orders
- Growth: $499/month, up to 100,000 tracked orders
- Enterprise: custom pricing, unlimited orders and a dedicated success manager

All plans include email support. Growth and Enterprise add Slack support.

# About Acme Analytics

Founded in 2019, Acme Analytics is built for lean e-commerce marketing teams who don't have a data engineer on staff. Our customers are typically 5-50 person DTC brands doing $2M-$50M in annual revenue.
